benchmark: Label robustness: Super VL on the two sample clips under several input conditions
reproduce: UNDERSTUDY_ENV_FILE=<path to .env.local> node scripts/bench-label.mjs --runs 5 --conditions h,i,j,k --out bench/results/label-extra.json

context.iss: aboard the ISS, plant growth experiment

task.iss: aboard the ISS, planting seed film into the Veggie plant pillows

conditions.prompt: LABEL_PROMPT of scripts/bench-session.mjs, verbatim; d adds one line saying the clip comes as captioned keyframes and a montage
conditions.order: run-major: run 1 of every clip and condition, then run 2, ...; sequential, one call at a time
conditions.retries: one retry after 5 s on a timeout, 429 or 5xx; none happened unless attempts > 1

iss:kf1280.note: 6 keyframes at the centres of 6 equal segments, JPEG q4; montage 12 frames 320 wide in a 4x3 tile

dev:kf1280.note: 6 keyframes at the centres of 6 equal segments, JPEG q4; montage 12 frames 320 wide in a 4x3 tile

conditions.prices: list prices from tests/fixtures/models.json ($0.30 in / $0.90 out per million for Super VL); video tokens priced as prompt tokens

iss.verb: some step has verb insert, or place with target.fixture pocket
iss.object: main object's name matches /seed|film|strip|tape/i and not /battery|drive|disk|hdd|ssd|cartridge|card|cell|module/i
iss.fixture: the first insert or place step's target.fixture is pocket
iss.size: main object's largest size_mm within a factor of 2 of 60 mm (30 to 120)
iss.diagnostic_scene: (not scored) some object name matches /pillow|plant|seed|veggie|root|growth/i and none matches /battery|hard.?drive|disk|hdd|ssd/i

dev.verb: no step has verb grasp, move, insert, place or release (nothing is moved in the clip; reach and retract are tolerated)
dev.fixture: no step targets a pocket or a stack (zone or no target)
dev.size: the first object named /board/ has largest size_mm within a factor of 2 of 270 mm (135 to 540); else the first named /piece|pawn|king|queen|knight|rook|bishop/ within a factor of 2 of 45 mm (22.5 to 90)
